name: Grilled sea urchin
summary: Sea urchin halved and grilled with oil, roasted peanuts, and spring onion until it turns creamy, then scooped out and dipped in lime and pepper. Expect zest, spice, and a fresh sea aroma.
origin: Phu Quoc. Grilled, and also served in other styles.
texture: The grilled urchin is creamy once it is tender. It also comes in other styles.
taste: Zest, spice, and a fresh aroma, from the lime and pepper sauce. Also with roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion, served with grilled oysters.
howToEat: Scoop it with a spoon and dip it in lime and pepper sauce.
It also comes with grilled oysters, roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion.
seoTitle: Nhum bien — grilled sea urchin on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Nhum biển is sea urchin grilled with peanuts and spring onion until creamy, then dipped in lime and pepper at the Dinh Cậu night market.
